steps.code:
# Compute most common genre for each playlist
from collections import Counter

for pl in all_playlists:
    genres = [song_genres[sid] for sid in pl['song_ids']]
    # Count genres, pick the most common; if tie, pick the one that appears first in the playlist order
    counter = Counter(genres)
    max_count = max(counter.values())
    # Get the first genre in playlist order that has max_count
    most_common = None
    for g in genres:
        if counter[g] == max_count:
            most_common = g
            break
    print(f"Playlist {pl['playlist_id']} ({pl['title']}): most common = {most_common}")

# Update each playlist title with the most common genre

    genres = [song_genres[sid] for sid in pl['song_ids']]
